mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, including development builds; there is no development-only opt-out. This sits alongside the recorded decision to enforce https everywhere, with no plaintext exception for any service.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
